# nonVersionCompatible

<link-summary>Checks whether a version falls short of the one required.</link-summary>

<web-summary>nonVersionCompatible() — Checks whether a version falls short of the one required. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/string</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function nonVersionCompatible(currentVersion: string, requiredVersion: string): boolean;
```

The negation of `isVersionCompatible`, for the guard clause that stops early when the environment is too old.

## Parameters

| Parameter         | Type     | Description                     |
| :---------------- | :------- | :------------------------------ |
| `currentVersion`  | `string` | The version in hand.            |
| `requiredVersion` | `string` | The minimum that is acceptable. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the current version is lower than required.

## Examples

### Leaving early

```javascript
nonVersionCompatible("1.2.0", "1.3.0"); // => true
```
